{{Toy |image1 = |-|Toy = [[File:TheRiotToy.png]] |-|Pack 1 = [[File:TheRiotPack.png]] |-|Pack 2 = [[File:TheRiotPack2.png]] |-|2D Image = [[File:Place.png]] |-|In Night 2 = [[File:RiotNight2.png]] |release_date = July 2022 |virtual_item = {{RLinkC|8667155936|Riot Shield}} |series = Series 12 |toy_type = Core Figure/Core Pack }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Roblox Core Pack - The Riot''' is an official Roblox toy that was released in July of 2022. The toy offers The Riot, an enemy that is not actually in the game. It has red skin, black helmet, grey shoulder-pads, vest and knee-pads. It also wields a riot shield and a police baton. When you buy the toy, one redeemable code is given, which allows you to get the {{RLinkC|8667155936|Riot Shield}} accessory on Roblox. You can also buy the '''Roblox Core Pack - The Riot''' with two mystery figures, one from Series 12 of the Roblox Toy line and the second from Celebrity Series 10. The toy is recommended for ages 6+ and is not suitable for children under 3 years old. ==Official Description== *'''Online''' *:The trouble's just begun when The Riot shows up on the frontlines! This tough but quick fighter from Paradoxum Games' Tower Defense Simulator charges into the crowd without mercy, pummeling opponents into next week while swatting heavy fire like flies. *'''On Pack''' *:The Riot from Paradoxum Games' Tower Defense Simulator pummels opponents into next week while swatting heavy fire like flies. ==Prices & Stores== Prices vary by country due to shipping costs and local currency. The stores in which you can buy the '''Roblox Core Pack - Accelerator''' depends on country. The toy is subject to availability. Generally, it costs around $14.99-$15.98 in the US, £7-£13.62 in the UK and €15.45 in the EU. The following list is a selection of the online stores that you can buy this item from. This is not meant to be a comprehensive list: *[https://www.walmart.com/ip/ROB-Core-Figures-Tower-Defense-Simulator-The-Riot-W12/103099868 Walmart] (US, Canada & Mexico) ==Trivia== *Oddly, The Riot that appears in this toy is not actually an enemy in-game. **it is a scrapped enemy from 2021 which would have functioned similarly to the [[Lunar Shield]]. * The Riot can be seen falling from the sky and being stuck into the ground in Night 2 of the 2025 Null and Void event.
